description: Search Airbnb listings by location and dates. Use when the user names Airbnb or asks for a vacation rental or whole home and is not asking about a specific trip in Tineo; for a generic place to stay use search_hotels. Returns a slim list of cards (title, type, rating, host, URL). location must be a city or area, not a whole country (ask the user which city). Each card has distance_km from the requested place and in_requested_area; listings outside the area come last. If none are in the area, say so with their distances and do NOT re-search the same place with a reworded location string. Amenity filtering only via the amenities enum; there is NO keyword/free-text filter, so tell the user anything else can't be filtered. If structuredContent.status is 'unavailable', do NOT retry the same search: share structuredContent.fallback_search_url (a prefilled airbnb.com search), offer a hotel search, or a support ticket.

amenities.description: Only listings with ALL of these amenities. These are the only supported amenity filters; there is no keyword/free-text filter.

infants.description: Infants under 2. Airbnb does not count them as guests.

location.description: City, neighborhood, or landmark with its region and country (e.g., 'Lisbon, Portugal', 'Brooklyn, NY, USA', 'Orange, NSW, Australia').

name: assistant_airbnb_search_user
title: Search Airbnbs
